title: Project 3 · Developer Dashboard
summary: Capstone-prep: file watcher + HTTP client + SQLite + background tasks under a tray-aware shell.
requirements: Watch a user-chosen directory (validate path) and stream change events as structured payloads
HTTP client panel (reqwest) fetching ONLY user-entered local URLs; 5s timeout enforced
Persist dashboard layout/settings via your migration'd SQLite layer
Background aggregation task with semaphore-bounded concurrency + cancel button
